content: Resolved, and the original premise was wrong. PHPUnit sets an <env> entry only when the variable is absent (no force="true" here), so CI overrides the DDEV values by exporting DB_*. Proved by running the suite with DB_DATABASE=nonexistent_db: it fails, meaning the environment wins. No separate testing env file is needed; phpunit.xml now documents this so the next reader does not re-raise it.
title: phpunit.xml hardcodes DDEV database credentials
